ces.definition: Complete canonical CES program, including EDIT_START and EDIT_END

pretrained_ces.definition: Same CES serialization; adaptation changes weights, not format

ar_dsl.definition: Complete textual edit program, including script delimiters

flat_relative.definition: Complete edit program with single-token relative coordinates

fim.definition: Gold changed envelope plus terminator; predicted FIM assumes correct localization

fim_predicted.definition: Gold changed envelope plus terminator; predicted FIM assumes correct localization

levenshtein.definition: Target sequence with boundaries only; not an autoregressive program or refinement-work count

roundtrip_checks: CES, AR-DSL, flat-relative and all regeneration/FIM references resolve to the same target text; 485/485 each
accounting: Full reference output representation, including its own delimiters; source/prompt excluded. Observed decode counts exclude prefilled controls and are a separate quantity.
